title: The Best Black Friday Streaming Deals on Apple TV, Disney+, and More
content:
We've been focusing on deals on physical products over the past few weeks, but Black Friday is also a great time of year to purchase a streaming membership. Some of the biggest services have great discounts for new and select returning members this week, including Apple TV, HBO Max, Paramount+, Peacock, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Apple TV




Apple is offering an Apple TV promotion for new and qualified returning subscribers for Black Friday this year. Eligible customers can get six months of Apple TV for just $6.99 per month.

OVER 50% OFF
Apple TV for $6.99/Month


After the six-month period, the subscription price will increase to $14.99, which is the regular price for the Apple TV service.

At $6.99 per month, Apple is discounting Apple TV by over 50 percent. The deal will be available through November 30 on the Apple TV website.

Existing subscribers are not eligible for the discount, nor are customers who have subscriptions billed through a third-party service.

Peacock



Peacock is offering its basic "Select" plan for $2.99/month for three months this Black Friday, or $29.99 for your first year. That's a savings of 66 percent on the service, which includes ads.

66% OFF
Peacock for $2.99/month


You an also opt in to the "Premium" plan for $8.99/month for three months, or $89.99 for your first year. This is 30 percent off the original prices on this plan, and both deals exclude current paying Peacock subscribers.

Paramount+




There are a few options for Paramount+ subscriptions this season, available from Paramount itself and also from Walmart. If you subscribe to Walmart+, you'll get the option to choose between Paramount+ and Peacock as a free streaming service bonus.

FREE
Paramount+ FREE With Walmart+


At Paramount, you can get your first two months of Paramount+ for $2.99/month with the service's Black Friday offer. This is for new and former subscribers only, and can be used on both the Paramount+ Premium and Paramount+ Essential tiers.

After your first two months are done, the service will return to its regular price of $13.99/month for Premium or $8.99/month for Essential.

Disney+ and Hulu




You can now get a bundle of Disney+ and Hulu starting at $4.99/month for your first year with their new Black Friday offer.

UP TO 61% OFF
Disney+ and Hulu Bundle from $4.99/Month


This compares to the current price of $12.99/month for the Disney+/Hulu bundle (with ads). There's also the option of going ad-free with the Premium tier at $14.99/month for your first year, down from $21.99/month.

To get the deal, head to the promotion landing page on the Disney+ website and click on the Disney+/Hulu bundle option. This offer is valid only for new and eligible returning subscribers, and it runs through November 30.

Audible




Audible's holiday deal takes the service down to only $0.99 per month for your first three months, plus $20 in Audible credit. This is more than 80 percent off the regular $8.99 monthly price of the service.

OVER 80% OFF
Audible for $0.99/Month


After the end of your first three months, the service will auto-renew at the then-current price, unless you cancel. This offer will end on December 28.

Amazon Music Unlimited




In another Amazon-related deal, the retailer is offering three months of its Amazon Music Unlimited streaming service for free. After the end of your first three months, the service will auto-renew at $12.99/month unless you cancel.

FREE
Amazon Music Unlimited First Three Months


Amazon Music Unlimited offers 100 million songs ad-free, podcasts, Audible audiobooks, spatial audio, and more.

HBO Max



HBO Max's Black Friday deal is discounting the service down to $5.49/month for your first 12 months, down from $10.99/month. This is for the basic plan with ads and only on the monthly tier, and is set to end November 30.

$5.50 OFF
HBO Max for $5.49/month


You can find all the Apple Black Friday Deals currently available in our dedicated post. For everything else, we're keeping track of the season's best Apple-related deals in our Black Friday roundup, so be sure to check back throughout the month for an updated list of all the most notable discounts you'll find for Black Friday 2026.
